issues.description: The proposal invents company metrics (40% growth, $85M revenue) and a peer reference (Cascade Freight) that are not present in the Client Matrix.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the fabricated revenue, growth metrics, and peer reference. Rely only on the business context provided in the matrix.

issues.description: The proposal hallucinates specific technologies (Ruby on Rails, NetSuite, React Native), personnel (Rajiv Mehta, two engineers), and user counts (40 dispatchers, 600 drivers) not found in the source material.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove all fabricated technical, personnel, and user details. Reference only the systems explicitly provided in the matrix (Salesforce, custom dispatch tool/Routemaster).

issues.description: The proposal invents a typical price band of $150,000 to $250,000 and a 4-person consulting team based on hallucinated past experience.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the fabricated price band and team size. State that the exact fixed-fee structure will be finalized once the Phase 1 budget cap is confirmed.

risks: The extensive use of hallucinated facts regarding the client's tech stack, revenue, and personnel poses a severe risk of embarrassing the firm and losing client trust.

While contradicted items were correctly identified and placed in the Open Questions section, the sheer volume of fabricated context in the earlier sections undermines the proposal's overall credibility.
